careerDirection.directionDescription: Entrepreneurship is a career path where the graduate chooses to create and run their own venture rather than work as an employee. Using the knowledge, skills, and domain expertise built through their degree, the graduate identifies an opportunity and builds a business around it — whether a local enterprise, a freelance practice, a professional service, a digital venture, or a scalable startup. The graduate is the owner, the decision-maker, and the driver of the work.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Human-AI interaction and UX research involves understanding how people interact with AI-powered systems and designing those interactions to be safe, useful, and trustworthy. UX researchers conduct user studies of AI products; user research analysts synthesise feedback from AI users; inclusive design analysts ensure AI interfaces work for diverse populations. BCA AI & ML graduates who develop psychology, research methods, and design thinking skills can build alternate careers in the nascent field of responsible AI design.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Data science and statistical analysis involves applying mathematical and statistical methods to extract insights from structured and unstructured data. Data scientists build predictive models; quantitative analysts apply statistics to financial and operational problems; data engineers build the pipelines that prepare data for analysis. BCA AI & ML graduates with Python, statistics, and ML library training are competitive for entry-level data scientist and data analyst roles, particularly after completing applied project portfolios.
